name: Task Status Cycler
description: Complete Pomodoros, toggle empty Pomodoro placeholders/sub-bullets with Ctrl+Alt+], toggle Obsidian tasks with Ctrl+Shift+] — prompting for promotion destinations in ordinary notes with Tasks plus another section (Enter defaults to Tasks conversion; non-Tasks stays plain; empty source sections are removed) and for demotions from Tasks — cycle Blocked tasks out with option+[/option+], recover affected Blocked dependents, propagate Ctrl+Enter to embedded task transclusions, and preserve embedded-task behavior.
author: Bryan
